items.answer: In the 2026 regular season, Cecilia Zandalasini averaged 8.6 points, 2.1 rebounds, and 1.7 assists in 37 games for the Golden State Valkyries.

items.question: What team does Cecilia Zandalasini play for?
items.answer: Cecilia Zandalasini plays forward for the Golden State Valkyries and wears No. 24. Golden State took her in the 2025 Expansion Draft, and she signed a one-year deal with the Valkyries on April 12, 2026.

items.question: Did Cecilia Zandalasini play for the Minnesota Lynx?
items.answer: Yes. Cecilia Zandalasini won the 2017 WNBA championship with the Minnesota Lynx. She played for Minnesota in 2017, 2018, and 2024 before joining Golden State.

items.question: Does Cecilia Zandalasini play for Italy?
items.answer: Yes. Cecilia Zandalasini represents Italy. She made the All-Star Five at EuroBasket 2017 after averaging 19.0 points and 9.6 rebounds, played for Italy at EuroBasket 2025, and was MVP of the 2016 U20 European Championship.

items.question: Did Cecilia Zandalasini play college basketball?
items.answer: No. Cecilia Zandalasini did not play U.S. college basketball. The WNBA lists her club as PF Schio in Italy, and she was not drafted before joining the WNBA.
